status: Frozen local pattern-audit protocol before running predictive comparisons; not externally preregistered
question: Does the measured response of an identical CRISPRi construct in one experimental context predict its response in the other better than a no-change baseline?
scope: K562 day6 dCas9-KRAB versus RPE1 day7 ZIM3-KRAB; factors are confounded
license: CC BY 4.0; publisher Figshare article20029387 version1
target_selector: Exact construct ID present in both archives, valid terminal Ensembl ID, >=20 num_cells_filtered in both; no energy/DE/knockdown/effect threshold
control_selector: Publisher core_control true and non-targeting label, finite positive num_cells_filtered
control_pooling: Weighted mean of raw pseudobulk construct means using num_cells_filtered before normalization
feature_universe: Shared measured Ensembl IDs, sorted lexically. This inherits each publisher archive's >0.01 UMI/cell all-population gene filter
transform: Natural log1p of 10000 times each raw pseudobulk gene mean divided by that row's sum over the shared measured gene universe; not mean(log1p(single-cell counts))

feature_views.primary: All shared measured genes, excluding the perturbed gene from each scored vector
feature_views.secondary: Top1000 shared genes by source-context pooled control abundance only, tie by Ensembl ID; exclude perturbed gene

predictions.control: Zero response relative to target-context control
predictions.same_construct_transfer: Source-context normalized construct vector minus source-context control; add target control only if representing endpoint mean
predictions.permuted_construct_transfer: Identical method after a fixed seed20260910 permutation rejecting any same-gene matches; diagnostic negative control

fit_boundary: Predictor receives source responses and target control only; no target perturbed expression is used to select features or change predictions
metrics: Per-construct response Pearson with undefined retained
MSE averaged across constructs within gene, then equally across target genes
Macro-MSE ratio to no-change, undefined for zero denominator
uncertainty: No inferential confidence interval or broad context-generalization claim from two confounded contexts; construct/pseudobulk rows are not independent biological contexts
success_or_failure: Report both directions and every prespecified feature view; transfer failing to beat zero response shows this fixed cross-context response transfer is inadequate in that direction. It does not establish or refute IDA or a causal network
